svg.title: ORCA model overview
svg.desc: The four-module design and validation cycle is connected by a broad arrow to Modeling data in the whole-body delivery overview. Modeling data connects only to the RNA product composition panel at lower right. The other panels show systemic distribution, barrier and expression, and tissue coverage.

g.title: Whole-body delivery model
g.desc: Systemic distribution, barrier transport and expression, explicit RNA product states, and a complementary tissue coverage model. Central modeling data informs RNA product composition. Outputs distinguish intended-product retention, unwanted-edit burden, and tissue coverage. Schematic only; no measured data are depicted.
g.metadata: Scientific source: wiki/pages/software.html. AI-assisted art direction; original Python vector construction. Reproduce with scripts/draw_delivery_overview.py. Created 2026-10-16. License: CC BY 4.0, as in the repository.
